title: Sleepy duckling
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#FFD93B'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='26' ry='17' fill='#FFE97F'/>
  <!-- wing -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='68' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#F5C518'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M74 62 Q86 54 78 66 Q84 64 76 72 Z' fill='#FFD93B'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='36' r='19' fill='#FFD93B'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='34' r='17' fill='#FFE97F'/>
  <!-- sleepy eyes: closed curved lines -->
  <path d='M37 34 Q41 30 45 34' stroke='#8A5A00' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53 34 Q57 30 61 34' stroke='#8A5A00' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='42' r='4' fill='#FF9E7A' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='4' fill='#FF9E7A' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M42 44 Q48 52 54 44 Q48 47 42 44 Z' fill='#FF8C42'/>
  <path d='M42 44 Q48 47 54 44 L54 46 Q48 50 42 46 Z' fill='#E56E1F'/>
  <!-- little tuft -->
  <path d='M44 18 Q48 10 52 18 Q50 14 48 17 Z' fill='#F5C518'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M70 22 h6 l-6 6 h6' stroke='#B9E6FF' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M78 12 h4 l-4 4 h4' stroke='#B9E6FF' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
